name: Matthew Ng
headline: Hi, I'm Matthew Ng.
bio: I'm a strategy consultant in London, originally trained in biochemistry at Imperial before moving into management at LSE and consulting across healthcare, life sciences, and tech. Outside of work, I tinker with small software projects, design systems, and AI agent tools, mostly to learn by building. When I'm away from a screen, you'll usually find me bouldering, playing basketball or golf, lifting, or out for a run.
